title: Coronagraph Watch
text:
🔭 Coronagraph Watch — September 25, 2026

A new CME showed up in NASA’s DONKI, so Sunny is checking the Sun’s outer corona.

☀️ CME start: September 25, 2026 at 11:09 UTC
💨 CME speed: 754 km/s
🏷 CME SCORE: C-type (500–999 km/s)
📐 CME half-angle: 43° (Moderate)

Sunny is keeping watch. 👀🌌

Image: NOAA SWPC — LASCO C3
Data: NASA DONKI + NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
